strategy.action_description: Front-load the T=1/TOPK<=10 local-slot compaction before GEMM1 and make both GEMM stages consume the same compact local slot arrays. For the fast path, build local_slots, local_experts, token_counts, and local_slot_count first, launch GEMM1 only over the host-known TOPK upper bound with device guards against slot_idx >= local_slot_count[0], and write mid_compact[slot_idx, i] instead of mid[topk_slot, i]. Then pass the same compact slot index to the existing single-token GEMM2 path. Keep GEMM1/GEMM2 arithmetic, FP4 decode helpers, router weights, and fallback paths unchanged; the isolated change is scheduling the local expert work once and reusing it across both GEMMs.
strategy.evidence_chain: Profile evidence: generation 6 selected 6ebb0ad6 as best at 533.856 us, but the current auto baseline is still around 527.168 us for qwen_tp2 T=1. Code evidence in 6ebb0ad6 shows stage1_activation_warp_k_kernel launches over all T*TOPK*I outputs and checks local expert membership inside every warp, while compact_single_token_local_slots_kernel runs only after GEMM1 and therefore only prunes GEMM2. Shape evidence: local_num_experts=256 out of num_experts=512, TOPK=10, so the current GEMM1 launch can spend warp scheduling and topk_id checks on non-local slots that must contribute zero. New L1 evidence: the SM120 MoE data-prep reference outputs compact expert-major maps once for downstream grouped GEMMs, with a single-CTA small-topk path preferred at small topk_length. Inference: the fastest parent has the right compact schedule, but it is used one stage too late. Action: move the schedule boundary before GEMM1 and reuse the compact rows through GEMM2.
strategy.expected_impact: Should reduce useless GEMM1 warp work for non-local top-k routes, remove repeated topk_id/local-range checks from the stage1 hot loop, and make the intermediate layout match the compact single-token GEMM2 path. The gain is shape-dependent: largest when only a subset of TOPK routes are local, neutral when all 10 slots are local.
strategy.risks: If most routed experts are local, the schedule movement may only add one earlier metadata dependency and little speedup. Row mapping mistakes can swap top-k slots, especially because topk_weights must still index the original slot. Keep the parent all-topk GEMM1 path as fallback for T!=1, TOPK>10, or any mismatch.
